Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded “they do not share the same nationality” after finding that Samantha Jo (Samantha Win) is Canadian American. Sharing nationality asks whether they have at least one nationality in common; since both are Canadian, the correct conclusion is that they do share Canadian nationality. This was a logical misinterpretation of “share the same nationality,” not supported by the sources.
